faces.name: You Exist Only to Amuse
faces.oracleText:
When you set this scheme in motion, choose one. If you control six or more lands, choose both instead.
• Create three 1/1 red Devil creature tokens with "When this token dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
• Until your next turn, creatures your opponents control have base power and toughness 1/1 and lose all abilities.

faces.name: You Encounter a Beholder!
faces.oracleText:
When you encounter this phenomenon, starting with you, each player rolls a d20. Players who control their commander roll with advantage. (They roll 2d20 and ignore the lower roll.)
1-9 | Create a Treasure token.
10-19 | Draw a card.
20 | Create a Treasure token, draw a card, then you may cast a spell from your hand without paying its mana cost.
(Then planeswalk away from this phenomenon.)
